{{Top|leg}}
'''Electro-chemical camouflage paint''' was used to treat [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and was highly reactive to electronic currents. When charged, the paint could adopt patterns and colorations that were similar to the surrounding environment. The [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[Doom Slayer]] was coated with electro-chemical camouflage paint.<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
